One Server per file in `servers/`. Point your editor at [`schema/v1/server.json`](/schema/v1/server.json) for completion and validation. Unknown keys are kept when Fauxfield saves the file.

## Server

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|

## Dataset

A named JSON collection backing stateful `crud` routes.

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | `string` | required |  |
| `seed` | `string` |  | Static JSON seed file (workspace-relative). |
| `seed_template` | `string` |  | Tera template rendering to JSON (workspace-relative). |
| `generator` | [`GeneratorSeed`](#generatorseed) |  | Declarative generator seed; a third seed source. |
| `key` | `string` |  | Field holding each item's identifier (default `id`). |
| `id_strategy` | `string` |  | `uuid` (default), `increment` or `ulid`. |
| `persist` | `boolean` | `false` | true: mutations are written to `.fauxfield/state/` and reloaded on start. |
| `columns` | array of [`DatasetColumn`](#datasetcolumn) |  | Optional column list: drives the Data Table's cell editors and validation. |
| `description` | `string` |  | Free-text description. |

| `pinned` | `boolean` |  | In `passthrough` mode keep this Route mocked instead of forwarding it. |
| `mode` | `string` |  | `websocket` routes: `echo`, `script` or `broadcast` (default `echo`). |
| `messages` | array of [`WsMessage`](#wsmessage) |  | `websocket` routes: scripted messages. |

## Response

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | `string` | required |  |
| `name` | `string` |  |  |
| `description` | `string` |  | Optional one-line note shown under the name. Not sent. |
| `default` | `boolean` | `false` |  |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | true: skipped by response selection. |
| `rules_logic` | `string` |  | `and` (default) or `or`. |
| `rules` | array of [`Rule`](#rule) | `[]` |  |
| `status` | `integer` | `200` |  |
| `schema` | `string` |  | JSON Schema file (workspace-relative) used by the API documentation. |
| `content_type` | `string` |  |  |
| `body` | `string` |  |  |
| `body_file` | `string` |  |  |
| `template` | `boolean` |  | false: body, body_file and header values are sent verbatim (default true). |
| `delay_ms` | [`Delay`](#delay) |  | Milliseconds, or a range such as `"200..800"`. |
| `fault` | `string` |  | `none`, `timeout`, `reset`, `close`, `empty`, `malformed` or `slow_body`. |
| `fault_rate` | `number` |  | 0.0-1.0 probability that `fault` applies (default 1.0). |
| `headers` | map of `string` | `{}` | In file order (rows of the Response headers editor keep the order they were written in). |
| `actions` | array of [`DatasetAction`](#datasetaction) |  | Dataset actions: ordered, atomic as a group, run after this Response is chosen and before the body renders. |
| `action_error_status` | `integer` |  | Status returned when an action fails and the group is rolled back (default 409). |
| `callbacks` | array of [`Callback`](#callback) |  | Outgoing HTTP requests fired after this Response is sent. |

## Delay

A fixed delay in ms, or a `"min..max"` range.

No keys.

## DatasetAction

One step of a Response's Dataset actions. Every input is a Tera expression over
the request (`request.params.id`, `request.body.qty`, `action.0.id`,...).

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `dataset` | `string` | required | Name of a Dataset of the same Server. |
| `op` | `string` | required | One of [`ACTION_OPS`]. |
| `key` | `string` |  | Row key for `update`, `delete`, `set`, `increment` (array Datasets). |
| `filter` | map of `string` |  | `delete_where`: CRUD-style filters, e.g. `stock_gte = "{{ request.query.min }}"`. |
| `row` | `string` |  | `insert`/`update`: template rendering a JSON object. Default: the request body. |
| `fields` | map of `string` |  | `insert`/`update`: fields merged over `row`; values are Tera expressions. |
| `mode` | `string` |  | `update` on a row or singleton: `merge` (default) or `replace`. |
| `field` | `string` |  | `set`/`increment`: dotted field path. |
| `value` | `string` |  | `set`: the new value (Tera expression; JSON when it parses as JSON). |
| `by` | `string` |  | `increment`: amount, default 1; may be negative. |
| `fail_if` | `string` |  | Tera expression evaluated after the step with `result` in scope; `true` aborts the group. |
| `disabled` | `boolean` |  | true: step skipped. |

## Callback

A Callback (webhook simulation): an outgoing request fired after the Response is
sent. `url`, `headers` and `body` are Tera templates; `callback.body` (the rendered body) is
available to header templates for signing.

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | `string` | required |  |
| `name` | `string` |  | Friendly label shown in the Callbacks table. |
| `description` | `string` |  | One-line note; not sent. |
| `method` | `string` |  |  |
| `url` | `string` | `""` |  |
| `delay_ms` | `integer` |  | Wait before the first attempt. |
| `headers` | map of `string` | `{}` |  |
| `body` | `string` |  |  |
| `retries` | `integer` |  | Extra attempts after a failure (connection error, timeout or 5xx). Default 0. |
| `backoff_ms` | `integer` |  | First retry wait; doubles on each further retry (default 500). |
| `timeout_ms` | `integer` |  | Per-attempt timeout (default 10000). |
| `disabled` | `boolean` |  |  |

## Operation

The Responses of one operation of a `crud` Route.

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `responses` | array of [`Response`](#response) | `[]` | Tried in order; the first whose Rules pass is sent. No match runs the built-in handler. |

## WsMessage

One scripted message of a `websocket` Route.

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `trigger` | `string` | required | `connect`, `interval` or `message`. |
| `every` | `string` |  | `interval` trigger: period like `500ms`, `5s`, `1m`. |
| `when` | [`Rule`](#rule) |  | `message` trigger: condition on the incoming frame (`body` target, `key` = JSONPath). |
| `body` | `string` | `""` | Templated message body (text frame; base64 bytes when `binary`). |
| `format` | `string` |  | `compact` (default), `pretty` (2 spaces) or `raw`: how a rendered body that is valid JSON is sent. Anything that is not JSON is sent as it is. |
| `binary` | `boolean` |  | true: `body` is base64 and sent as a binary frame. |
| `close_code` | `integer` |  | When set the connection is closed with this code after sending. |
